description: This file defines a SalesOrderItem class inheriting from frappe.model.document.Document, representing a Sales Order Item in the ERPNext system. It also includes a function to update database indexes related to the Sales Order Item doctype.

classes.name: SalesOrderItem
classes.description: Represents a sales order item in the ERP system, inheriting from the generic Document class.

methods.name: on_doctype_update()
methods.description: Updates database indexes for the Sales Order Item doctype, specifically indexing item_code and warehouse fields.
